# Baseline First And Single API Configuration

Freeze authoritative evidence before implementation and define one testable browser-to-server address contract.

## What Happened

SALUS Pramana t9.1 moved baseline capture into the blocking scaffold phase and made the target use
same-origin `/api`, one Vite development proxy, Express port 8787, and one CORS allowlist. A
configuration test rejects absolute client API bases, duplicate proxies, and divergent ports.

## Takeaway

Brownfield plans must make baseline capture a dependency, not a final comparison task. For combined
Vite/Express applications, designate one API addressing authority and test every proxy, environment,
server, and CORS reference against it before feature work begins.
